definitions.explanation: Having or using many colors. Used as a modifier to describe printing, dyeing, art, and design that involves more than one or two colors.

examples.japanese: {多色|たしょく}{刷|ず}りのポスターを{作|つく}った。
この{花瓶|かびん}は{多色|たしょく}の{釉薬|ゆうやく}が{美|うつく}しい。
examples.english: The multicolored glaze on this vase is beautiful.

examples.japanese: {多色|たしょく}ボールペンは{一本|いっぽん}で{何色|なんしょく}も{使|つか}えるので{便利|べんり}だ。
examples.english: A multicolor ballpoint pen is convenient because you can use several colors with one pen.

notes:
Composed of {多|た} (many) and {色|しょく} (color). Primarily used as a modifier before nouns with の, or in compound words. Common in printing, art, and product descriptions. The {多|た}+noun pattern is productive in Japanese ({多目的|たもくてき}, {多方面|たほうめん}, etc.).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {多色|たしょく}{刷|ず}り: multicolor printing
- {多色|たしょく}ボールペン: multicolor ballpoint pen
- {多色|たしょく}{印刷|いんさつ}: polychrome printing
- {多色|たしょく}のデザイン: multicolored design

SIMILAR WORDS:
- カラフル: colorful — a loanword with a more casual, everyday feel
- {極彩色|ごくさいしき}: richly colored, vivid coloring — implies brilliant, splendid use of many colors
- {単色|たんしょく}: monochrome, single color — the opposite of {多色|たしょく}
